High level product asks and mitigations:
- Recommend short-term behavioral changes for Shoploom during burst window:
  * Generation length cap: 250 tokens default, 150 tokens for highest-risk routes.
  * Embedding batching: increase batch sizes and reduce frequency to every 15s for non-interactive refreshes.
  * Use quantized variant (redwood-3b-q4) for high-volume background embedding jobs.
- Fallback policy: if latency > 800ms sustained for 60s, switch to a lower-cost variant and send 429-suggested header to clients for graceful backoff.
- Safety nets: automatic output truncation (stop at sentence boundary) and structured prompts to minimize extraneous tokens.

Product will prepare a short integration checklist for the customer (two pages) and a sample prompt bundle we can share. ETA: Tue EOD (tomorrow).

— Irene
